诗仙李白行吟江畔.en: William Shakespeare is trying out a few lines by the river.
诗仙李白行吟江畔.zh-CN: 威廉·莎士比亚正在河畔试写几句台词。

长江之滨聆听诗仙真意。.en: Met William Shakespeare on the Great Riverbank and received Ancient Reserve and the Tavern Versebook.
长江之滨聆听诗仙真意。.zh-CN: 在大河岸结识威廉·莎士比亚，获赠陈年佳酿和酒馆诗集。

description.zh-CN: 听过莎士比亚的十段河畔小剧场。

text.en: All the world's a stage. This river has taken that as permission to drown out the actors.
text.zh-CN: 整个世界都是舞台。这条河却以为，自己可以放开嗓门，把演员的声音全盖过去。

text.en: William Shakespeare? I'd ask it to keep the rushing to the action scenes.
text.zh-CN: 威廉·莎士比亚？我会建议它，把奔腾的劲头留到打戏。

text.en: Every traveler arrives with a story. Half begin, 'It was like that when I found it.'
text.zh-CN: 每位旅人都带着故事。一半人的开头是：“我找到它时，它已经这样了。”

text.en: Mine begins with a man named Grimm. After that, the explanations get less convincing.
text.zh-CN: 我的故事，开头是一个叫格林的人。再往下，就越解释越难让人信了。

text.en: A king wanted a heroic speech. I offered him a quiet exit. He said it lacked majesty.
text.zh-CN: 一位国王想要一段英雄演说。我替他安排了悄悄退场，他嫌不够威风。

text.en: Did you explain that staying alive is an excellent dramatic choice?
text.zh-CN: 你有没有告诉他，活下来，也是一种很出色的戏剧选择？

text.en: I wrote a forest that moves. The trees here insist they're waiting for better roles.
text.zh-CN: 我写过一座会移动的森林。这里的树却坚持说，得先等到更好的角色。

text.en: I'd settle for one that doesn't drop branches on us.
text.zh-CN: 我要求不高，别往我们头上掉树枝就行。

text.en: That innkeeper wants a tragedy about unpaid tabs. He says the research is already finished.
text.zh-CN: 那位旅店老板，想要一出讲欠账的悲剧。他说，素材已经全备齐了。

text.en: If you use my name, make it a very short play.
text.zh-CN: 要是用了我的名字，请把戏写短一点。

text.en: The moon has inspired a sonnet. The mosquito has inspired several shorter words.
text.zh-CN: 月亮让我想出了一首十四行诗。蚊子则让我想出了好几个更短的词。

text.en: Try the sonnet first. The mosquito's already getting applause.
text.zh-CN: 先念诗吧。蚊子那边，已经有人在鼓掌了。

text.en: Two rival captains asked me to judge their quarrel. I suggested they try listening. Neither had rehearsed that part.
text.zh-CN: 两位互不服气的队长，请我评理。我建议他们试着听别人说话，可谁都没排练过这一段。

text.en: A difficult role. Almost no sword work.
text.zh-CN: 这角色确实难演，几乎没有拔剑的机会。

text.en: One traveler read me a love poem meant for three different people. At last, a tragedy with efficient casting.
text.zh-CN: 有位旅人，念了一首准备送给三个人的情诗。总算遇到一出选角很有效率的悲剧。

text.en: Did you tell them the audience might compare notes?
text.zh-CN: 你有没有提醒他，观众之间，可能会互相对一对词？

text.en: I've found a splendid ending: everyone gets home, the swords stay sheathed, and dinner is still warm.
text.zh-CN: 我想到了一个好结局：人人平安到家，剑没有出鞘，晚饭也还是热的。

text.en: Keep that one. We could use it.
text.zh-CN: 这个结局，请留着。我们很用得上。

text.en: You're back. Ten meetings, and not once have you tried to sell me a tragic backstory. Remarkable.
text.zh-CN: 你又来了。见了十回，居然一次都没打算卖给我一个悲惨身世。难得。

text.en: I thought you preferred to get those for free.
text.zh-CN: 我以为，你更喜欢免费听这些。

text.en: Only the first draft. You've been a fine audience, even when the jokes weren't.
text.zh-CN: 只限初稿。你一直是位好观众，就算有些笑话不怎么好笑。

text.en: Does a fine audience get a reward?
text.zh-CN: 那好观众，有没有奖赏？

text.en: Usually applause. Unfortunately, I drank the budget.
text.zh-CN: 通常会有掌声。可惜，我把预算喝掉了。

text.en: A bold approach to theater management.
text.zh-CN: 真是一种大胆的剧院经营方式。

text.en: A bottle of Ancient Reserve, and my Tavern Versebook. Keep the bottle safe; use the book to learn Drunken Brawl.
text.zh-CN: 给你一瓶陈年佳酿，还有我的酒馆诗集。酒先好好留着；使用诗集，可以学会醉酒乱斗。

text.en: Until our next meeting. May your exits be graceful and your footing less experimental.
text.zh-CN: 后会有期。愿你退场时足够潇洒，走路时少点即兴发挥。
